answer_1.quote: ...we have undertaken the first extensive benchmarking of LLMs on temporal reasoning tasks...

answer_4.quote: ...Human evaluations were carried out using 100 random samples from the TNLI, BIG-bench, and TimeQA datasets, assessed by three in-house annotators...
